summary: Keep gateway typing local to the iOS pairing screen and save the latest edited value explicitly.

schema.detail: No durable schema or wire changes.

rules.detail: Gateway validation and pairing permissions are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Gateway edits stay local while typing; external profile changes still replace the field and leaving the screen retains unfinished edits. Save reads the latest local value, including before the next React render.

downtime.detail: No migration or coordinated downtime is required.

manual.detail: In the pairing screen, edit a gateway, save immediately, reopen the screen and verify the saved value. Verify QR prefill and external profile changes still replace the field.

recovery.detail: Saved profiles and credentials retain their existing format; normal app rollback applies.
